Arrakis is calling. DUNE: AWAKENING unveils an epic new story set within an alternate Dune timeline, where the mysterious disappearance of the Fremen draws a lone survivor into a deadly struggle for spice, power and control of the desert.

From colossal sandworms and violent Coriolis storms to warring factions, hidden conspiracies and brutal battles across the dunes, survival is only the beginning. Enter the cinematic world of Dune as alliances are forged, enemies rise and one Sleeper begins the journey from nothing to greatness on the most dangerous planet in the universe.
